title: Unique & Godforged
notes: NEW: 9 Unique items (turquoise) with effects you can't get anywhere else: lightning strikes, healing crits, Phoenix revive, dodge, Oni grudge, Ki boost and more.
NEW: 5 Godforged 神器 items after Master 99, the Japanese god-relics: Kusanagi, Yata Mirror, Yasakani Magatama, Susanoo's Storm Plate, Izanagi's Crown.
Uniques drop from bosses: Gate B+, Tower every 10th floor, Master Gate, Master League, Rift and Paragon. Bad-luck protection raises the chance after every miss.
NEW: Loot Codex (Gates tab and Bag): where everything drops, the chances and your collection.
Uniques drop at your level, are auto-locked, and can be reforged to your current level for Gold + Mana Stones.
Unique effects count in Power, so Equip Best keeps them.
